articles.title: A Secret Theater Underground: Brooklyn Subway Gets a Sparkly Surprise
articles.summary: Imagine waiting for the train and suddenly you're at a carnival! New glass mosaics at Church Avenue station celebrate Flatbush's forgotten vaudeville stars and Afro-Caribbean parades. Over 10,000 people see them every day.

articles.title: Harry Styles's Secret Show: No Nipples, Just Pure Magic
articles.summary: Harry Styles ditched the stadium and played a tiny, one-night-only show with an orchestra. He sang a cover of "Bridge Over Troubled Water" that was so beautiful, people say it's the best he's ever sounded. Even his nipples stayed hidden!

articles.title: The Piano Whisperer: Remembering Abdullah Ibrahim, South Africa's Mozart
articles.summary: Abdullah Ibrahim, a jazz pianist so good Nelson Mandela called him South Africa's Mozart, has died at 91. He made music that felt like a quiet prayer, and his song "Mannenberg" became an unofficial anthem for freedom.
